summary: Iteration 4: tested day status (festivo/suspendida/normal) and student self check-in with a 4-digit code. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass, covering PUT /api/class-days (200/400/409/422/401), the cancelled map, admin and public attendance rejected on cancelled days, public search (min 3 chars, max 10, only id+name, regex-safe), /public/me balances + available_days (past days only, cancelled days excluded), public attendance (future 400, Monday 400, duplicate 409, no classes 400, success decrements and source='alumno'), wrong code 401, and lockout after 5 failures per student and per IP (429, spoofed XFF does not bypass; backend restarted after). All 57 real students have 4-digit codes. Frontend (375x667): /bienvenida -> /mi-clase works end to end: search, no-results, wrong code error clears the input, balance, day chips (festivo 2026-11-03 excluded), register success updates balance and removes the chip, checkin-no-bono for a student with 0 classes, exit. Alumnos: day-options modal works; festivo/suspendida show the banner, a struck-through greyed chip and a disabled 'Sin clase' button; back to normal works; the 409 error toast shows on a day with attendances; student-code-value shows the correct code; Historial shows '· registrado por el alumno'. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: The per-IP code lockout (5 failures / 15 min) is shared by every student behind the same public IP (gym WiFi/NAT). Five typos from any students together block self check-in for the whole class for 15 minutes. Consider a higher per-IP threshold (e.g. 20-30) and keep the per-student limit at 5.
Anyone can lock a specific student out for 15 min by entering 5 wrong codes for them (DoS). Low risk, but worth knowing.
Not atomic: it counts attendances, then sets the status. An attendance registered at the same moment can end up on a day marked festivo. Low risk.
Unauthenticated name lookup: anyone with the URL can list students' full names 3 letters at a time. This is by design but is a privacy consideration.

issues: checkin-no-bono warning box uses white text on orange (~2.2:1 contrast, below WCAG AA). Use dark text (onWarning dark) or a darker orange.
Only the 12 most recent pending days are shown. Older unregistered days cannot be reached (acceptable, but note it).
Long list (57+ students) has no search/filter, so the monitor has to scroll a lot to find a student.
'Sin clase'/'Sin bono' disabled buttons: white text on light grey has low contrast.

action_items: Optional: raise the per-IP code-failure threshold (students share the gym IP) and keep per-student = 5
Optional: improve contrast of the orange warning box in mi-clase (checkin-no-bono)

critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx is 846 lines. Split it into modules.
todayYMD() in src/utils/dates.ts uses the device timezone while the backend uses Europe/Madrid. The 'Hoy' label/default day can differ for devices outside Spain (minor).
set_day_status check-then-upsert is not transactional (low-risk race).
public_search_students imports re inside the function. Move it to module level.
